root_idea.summary: The root centers on ugliness, badness, and what is regarded as foul, harmful, distressing, or disgraceful.
root_idea.development: From perceived ugliness or bad appearance, the lexical field extends to evil conduct, harmful or distressing conditions, misfortune, shameful exposure, and the evil outcome of an act.

senses.definition: To be or become evil, bad, foul, or unseemly; to be an evil course, result, or outcome.
senses.usage_conditions: Used evaluatively in constructions comparable to بَئْسَ, including expressions in which a course, destination, abode, action, or result is judged evil.

senses.definition: To displease, grieve, vex, or distress someone.
senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively; passive forms describe someone being distressed or an outward sign of grief or displeasure.

senses.definition: To do evil, act wrongly, or treat someone badly.
senses.usage_conditions: May be construed with prepositions such as إِلَى, لِ, عَلَى, or بِ; it is the opposite of أَحْسَنَ in conduct.

senses.definition: More or most evil, bad, ugly, or objectionable; worst.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as an elative adjective in comparison or superlative evaluation.

senses.definition: One who does evil or acts wrongly; an evildoer.
senses.usage_conditions: Active-participial use of Form IV أَسَاءَ, describing a person characterized by evil conduct.

senses.definition: Evilness or badness, especially evil nature, conduct, or an evil deed.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a noun and also attributively in expressions describing a person, action, or quality as evil or displeasing.

senses.definition: The private parts or nakedness, understood as what is shameful to expose.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, refers to the private parts or exposed nakedness in the account of Adam and Eve and related clothing imagery.
A Quranic contextual use in which a dead body is something unseemly or shameful to leave exposed.

senses.definition: An evil act, deed, fault, offense, sin, or act of disobedience.
senses.usage_conditions: Opposed to حَسَنَة; the plural سَيِّئَات denotes multiple evil deeds or acts and may be used substantively.

senses.definition: An evil event, misfortune, affliction, or adverse consequence.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in contrast with حَسَنَة for an unwelcome circumstance or occurrence, including an evil outcome associated with what people have done.

senses.definition: Evil, bad, foul, unseemly, or objectionable.
senses.usage_conditions: Applied adjectivally to a thing, saying, action, quality, or circumstance; it may also be substantivized as “the evil.”

senses.definition: Evil, harm, injury, mischief, calamity, or any distressing or harmful condition.
senses.usage_conditions: The broad noun covers worldly, bodily, psychological, and eschatological distress; in constructions such as سُوءُ الْحِسَاب it denotes an evil or exacting reckoning, and in دَائِرَةُ السُّوء it can denote defeat, affliction, torment, perdition, destruction, or a similarly evil outcome.
A specialized Quranic interpretation in which سُوء denotes a debilitating or deranging affliction, not the ordinary generic sense of evil.

senses.definition: Leprosy or a comparable physical affliction.
senses.usage_conditions: A specialized Quranic interpretation of سُوء in expressions describing a hand or bodily condition; it should not be generalized to every occurrence of the noun.
A reported Quranic interpretation of a reading of سُوء in a context concerning the fate of earlier peoples; this is a specialized interpretation rather than the ordinary meaning of the noun.

senses.definition: The evil or worst end; an evil, ugly, or blameworthy act or condition, opposed to الْحُسْنَى.
senses.usage_conditions: Used substantively for what is evil or ugly and, in Quranic usage, for the evil outcome or end of those who act evilly.
A specialized Quranic interpretation of سُوءَى as the evil end or Hell-fire, associated with its opposition to الْحُسْنَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold or form an evil opinion of someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction سُؤْتُ بِهِ ظَنًّا or سُؤْتُ بِهِ الظَّنَّ, with the case of ظنّ varying according to the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To imprecate or disgrace someone by saying, in effect, “May God remove his face from good.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression involving سُؤْتُ وَجْهَ فُلَانٍ and related forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To corrupt, mar, or spoil something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Opposed to rectifying or setting something right.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disapprove of someone’s deed and tell them that they have done ill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative or interpersonal use involving criticism or reproach of an action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mar, spoil, or fail to do something well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a thing or task that has been performed badly or spoiled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To experience something disliked, displeasure, grief, or anxiety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive; may describe becoming upset or distressed on account of an event or report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weakness of the eye or impaired eyesight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare technical use reported for the noun with ḍamma; it is not a general Quranic meaning of سُوء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pudendum or external genital organs, and the anus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A precise anatomical use underlying the broader notion of private parts or nakedness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Any saying, action, quality, custom, or thing of which one is ashamed; a disgrace or disgraceful act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred use derived from the shame associated with exposure of the private parts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A contrarious or difficult wife or woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use of the definite feminine form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression ضَرَبَ فُلَانٌ عَلَى فُلَانٍ سَايَةً, either to do something displeasing or evil to someone, or to make a way toward achieving one’s purpose with him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical analysis is disputed: the expression is explained either from سَوْء or from a related form meaning to make or smooth a way.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The recompense or consequence of an evil act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the evil act itself to what is returned or brought about by it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Evil, bad, ugly, or abominable when applied directly to a man or woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributive use describing a person rather than an elative comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grief or vexation; a vice, fault, defect, disease, or act of disobedience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote either the experience or cause of distress, or defects and faults regarded as objectionable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the phrase خَزْيَانُ سَوَانُ, ashamed, base, vile, ignominious, and evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic or altered form whose second element is explained in connection with أَسْوَأُ.
